exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Are there many animals or birds where you live? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: How often do you watch programmes or read articles about wild animals? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Have you ever been to a zoo or a wildlife park? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Would you like to have a job working with animals? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a website you use that helps you a lot in your work or studies. You should say: what the website is how often you use the website what information the website gives you and explain how your work or studies would change if this website didn't exist.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Why do some people find the internet addictive?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: What would the world be like without the internet?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you think that the way people use the internet may change in the future?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: What are the ways that social media can be used for positive purposes?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Why do some individuals post highly negative comments about other people on social media?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Do you think that companies' main form of advertising will be via social media in the future?
